cases.note: Not evidence that the connector name is checked: this test binary links no integrations package, so no connector is declared and the boot check warns instead of refusing (component/memql/origin_boot_check.go). Every node binary serves shopify (app/plugins_core.go), where the same line is checked and resolves.

cases.message: @mirroredTo on a concept takes one or more strings
@mirroredTo is not valid on a concept whose @origin is "shopify"
cases.note: A mirror that also publishes is a second origin wearing the first one's badge (epic memql#4378).
